newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean bond yields end at new 1997 low.
newsitem.headline: South Korean bond yields end at new 1997 low.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds finished at a new 1997 low of 11.65 percent on Wednesday on the back of aggressive buying by institutional investors, traders said.
This was the lowest level since June 20, 1996, when the yields dropped to 11.65 percent.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.65 pct vs 11.85 pct
* 3-mth CDs end at 11.95 pct vs 12.19 pct
Three-month cerficates of deposit (CD) yields also fell to a new year low of 11.95 percent on improving liquidity conditions.
